test_cases.scenario: Login page shows OAuth sign-in button when AUTH_MODE is oauth
test_cases.steps: Configure AUTH_MODE=oauth in app settings. Navigate to /login/.
test_cases.expected: An OAuth sign-in button is visible. No classic email/password form is shown.

test_cases.scenario: OAuth button displays the configured provider name
test_cases.steps: Configure an OAuth provider named 'Acme SSO'. Navigate to /login/.
test_cases.expected: Button label references the provider name (e.g. 'Sign in with Acme SSO' or similar).

test_cases.scenario: Classic email/password form is hidden in OAuth mode
test_cases.steps: Set AUTH_MODE=oauth. Navigate to /login/.
test_cases.expected: Email and password fields are not visible on the page.

test_cases.scenario: Login page loads without errors in OAuth mode
test_cases.steps: Set AUTH_MODE=oauth. Navigate to /login/.
test_cases.expected: Page loads successfully. No JavaScript errors in the console. No blank or broken UI.

test_cases.scenario: App name and branding render correctly on the OAuth login page
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/ with OAuth mode active.
test_cases.expected: App name and logo appear as configured. Theme (light/dark) is applied.

test_cases.scenario: Clicking the OAuth sign-in button redirects the browser to the IdP
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/. Click the OAuth sign-in button.
test_cases.expected: Browser is redirected to the configured IdP authorization URL (e.g. Keycloak, Google, Azure).

test_cases.scenario: IdP redirect URL contains the correct redirect_uri back to the app
test_cases.steps: Click the OAuth sign-in button. Observe the redirect URL in the browser address bar.
test_cases.expected: The redirect_uri parameter points back to the app's OAuth callback URL.

test_cases.scenario: IdP redirect URL contains a state parameter
test_cases.steps: Click the OAuth sign-in button. Inspect the IdP redirect URL.
test_cases.expected: A state parameter is present and non-empty in the authorization URL query string.

test_cases.scenario: Button shows a loading or disabled state while redirect is being prepared
test_cases.steps: Click the OAuth sign-in button. Observe the button immediately after clicking.
test_cases.expected: Button is disabled or shows a loading indicator to prevent double-clicks.

test_cases.scenario: Redirect URL contains the expected OAuth scopes
test_cases.steps: Click the sign-in button. Inspect the IdP redirect URL.
test_cases.expected: Scope parameter is present (e.g. openid, email, profile).

test_cases.scenario: Returning from the IdP with a valid code and state logs the user in
test_cases.steps: Complete OAuth login at the IdP. Return to the app callback URL with a valid code and matching state.
test_cases.expected: User is authenticated. Browser is redirected to the main application (e.g. dashboard or home page).

test_cases.scenario: User is redirected to the application after successful OAuth login
test_cases.steps: Complete the full OAuth flow at the IdP.
test_cases.expected: Browser lands on the main app page. No login page is shown again.

test_cases.scenario: Session is active after successful OAuth login
test_cases.steps: Complete OAuth login. Navigate to a protected route.
test_cases.expected: Protected route loads. User is not redirected back to /login/.

test_cases.scenario: User's email address from the IdP is reflected in the active session
test_cases.steps: Complete OAuth login with SSO user email 'sso@example.com'. Check the logged-in user's email in the app.
test_cases.expected: App displays or stores 'sso@example.com' as the authenticated user's email.

test_cases.scenario: User's name from the IdP is stored on the account
test_cases.steps: Complete OAuth login with a provider that returns given_name and family_name. Inspect the user's profile.
test_cases.expected: First name and last name are populated from the IdP response.

test_cases.scenario: Tampered or mismatched state parameter shows an error to the user
test_cases.steps: Manually modify the state parameter in the callback URL and navigate to it.
test_cases.expected: App displays an error message. User is not logged in. No session is established.

test_cases.scenario: Callback URL with no code parameter shows an error
test_cases.steps: Navigate to the callback URL without a code query parameter.
test_cases.expected: App shows an error message. User is not logged in.

test_cases.scenario: Callback URL with no state parameter shows an error
test_cases.steps: Navigate to the callback URL without a state query parameter.
test_cases.expected: App shows an error message. User is not logged in.

test_cases.scenario: User denying consent at the IdP results in a friendly error message
test_cases.steps: Start OAuth flow. At the IdP authorization screen, deny/cancel consent.
test_cases.expected: IdP redirects back to the app. App shows a clear error or message. No crash or blank page.

test_cases.scenario: Using a callback URL with a replayed (already used) state shows an error
test_cases.steps: Complete a successful OAuth login. Re-use the same callback URL with the same state.
test_cases.expected: App rejects the replay. Error is shown. User is not logged in again via the stale state.

test_cases.scenario: Error message is user-friendly and does not expose internal details
test_cases.steps: Trigger an OAuth error (e.g. bad state). Inspect the error message shown to the user.
test_cases.expected: Message is readable and descriptive. No stack traces, internal exceptions, or raw server errors are shown.

test_cases.scenario: Error page provides a way to retry the login
test_cases.steps: Encounter an OAuth error. Observe the error page.
test_cases.expected: A 'Try again' link or button is available, returning the user to /login/.

test_cases.scenario: Navigating directly to the callback URL with no prior session shows an error
test_cases.steps: Without starting an OAuth flow, navigate directly to the callback URL with arbitrary code and state.
test_cases.expected: App detects no session state and shows an error. User is not logged in.

test_cases.scenario: First-time OAuth login creates a new user account
test_cases.steps: Complete OAuth login with an email address that has no existing account in the app.
test_cases.expected: A new user account is created. User lands on the app. Account email matches the IdP email.

test_cases.scenario: Returning OAuth user is not duplicated on subsequent logins
test_cases.steps: Complete OAuth login twice with the same IdP account.
test_cases.expected: Same user account is used both times. Only one account exists for that email.

test_cases.scenario: OAuth user cannot log in using classic email/password credentials
test_cases.steps: Create an account via OAuth login. Navigate to /login/ in classic mode. Attempt to log in with the same email and any password.
test_cases.expected: Login fails. No password is set on OAuth-created accounts.

test_cases.scenario: User profile reflects name information received from the IdP
test_cases.steps: Complete OAuth login with an IdP that returns first and last name. Visit the user profile page.
test_cases.expected: First and last name fields are populated from the IdP data.

test_cases.scenario: OAuth login button is reachable and activatable via keyboard
test_cases.steps: Navigate to /login/ in OAuth mode. Press Tab to focus the sign-in button. Press Enter.
test_cases.expected: Focus lands on the button. Pressing Enter initiates the OAuth redirect.

test_cases.scenario: OAuth login button has a visible focus ring
test_cases.steps: Tab to the OAuth sign-in button on /login/.
test_cases.expected: A visible focus indicator (outline or highlight) appears on the button.

test_cases.scenario: Login page with OAuth mode is usable on mobile (375px)
test_cases.steps: Open /login/ at 375px viewport width with AUTH_MODE=oauth.
test_cases.expected: OAuth button is fully visible and tappable. No horizontal scroll. No content overflow.

test_cases.scenario: Login page with OAuth mode is usable on tablet (768px)
test_cases.steps: Open /login/ at 768px viewport with OAuth mode.
test_cases.expected: Layout adapts correctly. Button and branding remain usable.

test_cases.scenario: OAuth state token is not visible in the page source or DOM
test_cases.steps: Start an OAuth flow. Before the IdP redirect, inspect the page source and DOM.
test_cases.expected: The generated state token is not embedded in the HTML source or any visible DOM attribute.

test_cases.scenario: Client secret is never present in any frontend payload or URL
test_cases.steps: Start an OAuth flow. Monitor all network requests from the browser.
test_cases.expected: No client secret appears in any request URL, request body, or response body visible to the browser.

test_cases.scenario: Dark mode applies correctly to the OAuth login page
test_cases.steps: Toggle to dark mode. Navigate to /login/ with OAuth mode.
test_cases.expected: All elements use the dark theme. No light-mode remnants visible.

test_cases.scenario: OAuth login page loads within 2 seconds on local dev
test_cases.steps: Open DevTools Network tab. Navigate to /login/ with OAuth mode.
test_cases.expected: DOM interactive within 2 seconds on local network.
